name: Player Profile Card UI
summary: Dark-tech player profile UI with avatar, username, user ID, session playtime and XP/level display.
install: Import the folder into a staging location and move its PlayerCard ScreenGui into StarterGui. ThumbnailCamera is an authoring helper, not required gameplay. Keep PlayerCardButton and the embedded LocalScript. The panel is generated by that script at runtime. Configure STAT_SOURCE_MODE and leaderstat names if integrating server-backed statistics.
limits: Original runtime-generated UI is preserved, not converted into a prebuilt editable panel. Default session XP/playtime are local demo values, not persistent authoritative progression. Mobile/gamepad and saved progression are unverified.
credit: Embedded header identifies DevPanels and version V1.2; literal Creator: (you) text is preserved without treating it as verified authorship.
verification: Limited Studio Play check: original LocalScript generated the panel; opening and closing through its buttons succeeded, avatar loaded, and session playtime/XP advanced. Desktop viewport: 1325 x 761. No persistence or mobile/gamepad test.
